meta.purpose: Surface active applications that have gone quiet past a threshold, plus upcoming scheduled events, and stage the real-world follow-up action (find/contact a human on LinkedIn) — because application emails are usually no-reply. Powers the dashboard FollowUpsPanel (see design.json).
meta.scope: Human-in-the-loop. No LinkedIn scraping, no third-party enrichment APIs. Contact details are user-entered and remembered per application. The tool detects WHEN to follow up and stages WHERE; the user confirms WHO once.

dataModel.comment: New optional columns on the existing applications table. No new tables required.

last_contact_at.desc: Most recent meaningful contact for this application. Drives staleness. See derivation.

follow_up_status.desc: User override of the nudge. 'open' = eligible; 'snoozed' = hidden until snoozed_until; 'muted' = never nudge.

snoozed_until.desc: When a snoozed item becomes eligible again.

next_event_at.desc: Scheduled interview/call. Feeds the 'Coming up' group.

indexes: partial index on (follow_up_status, last_contact_at) WHERE status in active_statuses — keeps the dashboard query cheap.

lastContactDerivation.rule: last_contact_at = MAX(applied_at, latest associated email timestamp, last manual 'followed-up' timestamp).
notes: A no-reply confirmation email still counts as contact for timing purposes — it sets the clock, it just isn't a reply channel.
Recompute on: application create, email linked/promoted, and the followed-up action.
If never set, fall back to applied_at (or created_at).

config.comment: Server-side, single source of truth for thresholds. Expose as settings later.
config.timezone: user timezone if known, else server tz — do all day math in this tz

upcoming.eligible_when: next_event_at IS NOT NULL AND next_event_at BETWEEN now AND now + upcoming_window_days

linkedinStaging.comment: We never call LinkedIn. We only build a prefilled people-search URL the user opens in a new tab.
linkedinStaging.encode: URL-encode {company}; collapse legal suffixes (Inc, LLC) for better matches.
linkedinStaging.when: Returned per stalled item as linkedin_search_url. UI uses it for the 'Find contact' action when no contact is saved yet.
right_person_guidance_surfaced_to_user: Prefer a warm connection at the company over a cold recruiter.
Then the recruiter named in the email signature / job posting.
Then a technical/eng recruiter currently at the company.
Verify: current employee + recruiting/TA-for-engineering title. Avoid wrong-function recruiters and stale profiles.

messageTemplate.comment: Suggested LinkedIn/connection note, returned resolved per item. Short, professional, editable by user.
messageTemplate.template: Hi {first_name}, I recently applied for the {role} role at {company} ({applied_relative}) and wanted to express my continued interest. I'd welcome the chance to connect and answer any questions about my background.

placeholders.{applied_relative}: humanized applied_at, e.g. 'about two weeks ago'

counts.needs_contact: int (stalled items with no saved contact)

stalled.linkedin_search_url: string (present when has_contact=false; may also be included as fallback)

endpoints.purpose: Record an outreach. Sets last_contact_at = now and follow_up_status = 'open'. Removes the item from 'stalled' for another threshold window.
Existing endpoint, extended to accept the new fields so a user can save a contact and an event time.

stalled.suggested_message: Hi there, I recently applied for the Software Engineer role at Lockheed Martin (about three weeks ago) and wanted to express my continued interest...
Hi Jordan, I recently applied for the Back End Developer role at IBM (about two weeks ago) and wanted to express my continued interest...

edgeCases: No saved contact -> has_contact=false; UI shows 'Find contact' using linkedin_search_url. Once saved via PUT, future responses set has_contact=true and the UI shows 'Message {name}'.
Snoozed items are excluded until snoozed_until passes; then they reappear as 'open'.
Application emails are typically no-reply: the follow-up channel is always external (LinkedIn/connection), never an email reply. last_contact_at uses the email only for timing.
Missing last_contact_at falls back to applied_at/created_at so nothing is silently invisible.
All day math uses the configured timezone to avoid off-by-one 'days since' near midnight.

implementationNotes.query: Single query over applications filtered by active status + follow_up_status + last_contact_at threshold, ordered server-side; compute days_since and urgency in the service layer; resolve suggested_message there too.
implementationNotes.caching: React Query key ['dashboard','follow-ups']; invalidate on followed-up / snooze / PUT application and after promote.
implementationNotes.settings: Keep thresholds in config now; promote to a user settings row later without changing the response shape.
implementationNotes.migration: Add the new nullable columns; backfill last_contact_at = MAX(applied_at, latest linked email) in the migration.
